items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-09
items.q: one fellow was named Henry McCarty and the other fellow named Pete Lewis... So you were talking about that trio.

ctx.x: Who were the other players in the trio?
Well, one fellow was named Henry McCarty and the other fellow named Pete Lewis. What?
Yeah. Oh. So you were talking about that trio. Who else played in the trio?
